rule: closeWindowImmediately and closeTabImmediately outside undo are reached only after ViewerClose.intercept
Don't Save then Cancel in Ghostty's second dialog keeps the edits
bundle license notice is built from the esbuild metafile and the lock, fails on a license outside the allowed list
the web view controller is freed after stop
nested node_modules copies of a package are listed with their own license
AppleScript close window asks about edits in every tab of the group
the default entry of an optional option writes an empty value, not a Reset
a numeric field rejects values the Ghostty type does not accept
the comment over the performable list names only actions that have default keys
the log command given to the user matches the subsystem of the Debug build
closed_by: checked once by hand: log stream caught a line of the running Debug app with subsystem tarn and category viewer

rule: pane key tests set the typed character, so Dvorak and Colemak are covered
undo of a close whose files are gone leaves a pane with the tree, not an empty one
the rule 'an empty pane closes, one with files toggles the tree' lives in one place (ViewerModel.closeIfEmpty)
a pane created by a failed open is closed, an existing tree-only pane stays
undo of a closed pane or viewer does not overwrite a layout changed after the close; test: close viewer, split a terminal, undo, both terminals and the viewer present
a drag test ends with the browser's own events (real mouse), not a hand-sent dragend; after the drop body has no dragging class
every toast that promises Cmd+Z restores has a test pressing Cmd+Z in the same state (last tab of the last workspace) and a test with undo-timeout 0s
closing a tab with a dirty viewer asks Save, Don't Save, Cancel; test: dirty edit, tab.close, dialog shown

closing a tab by any path (tab.close, Cmd+W on the last terminal, window.close) with a dirty viewer shows the dialog; test: dirty edit, focus the terminal, pane.close, dialog visible, Cancel keeps the tab
with the window closed no key row with when terminal throws; test: close the last tab, press Cmd+F, Cmd+G, Cmd+K, no page errors
a claude session in every seeded repository and in one without docs/spec.md reaches Stop on Allow and on Deny
a new tab or split starts in the folder the focused shell moved to; test: cd, Cmd+T, pwd
every bus event that code emits has a subscriber; a check lists emit names and bus.on names and fails on an emit without a listener
each settings divergence from settings.md has a test on the app's input form: empty entry, out-of-range number, fraction for an integer option, empty font-family, applies note
workspace model rules from the app have paired tests: delete the first workspace, step into a folded one, empty subtitle with top tabs, reload with a viewer
with Settings open Cmd+W closes Settings and changes no workspace; terminal keys do not run under a modal
check(..., True) is forbidden; the condition comes from measuring the state after the action
a Ctrl+Alt chord with the AltGraph modifier and a printable key is not taken as a shortcut
Cmd+Z, Cmd+W and Cmd+K in the Find or Settings field do not run terminal commands
every stored part passes a shape check; test: null and broken JSON in each part, the page starts and the toast is visible; include the workspaces part
rm -rf / and rm -rf ~ answer with a refusal and the vfs does not change
names from Object.prototype (constructor, __proto__) are not commands
a shell that exited on its own is not put in undo and the toast does not promise Cmd+Z
dispose removes the document mouseup listener; test: count listeners before create and after dispose
dispose before boot finishes frees the terminal and starts no shell; test: undo-timeout 0s, Cmd+T then Cmd+W at once
a multi-line paste into the claude editor is one input, not one Enter per line (bracketed paste mode on inside the session)
a cancelled drag (dropEffect none) shows no new-window toast; refusal text is Drop on another pane
focus set before an asynchronous layout change is restored after it (show gives the terminal back, a focus request waits for the web view to join the window)
a hidden tree cannot hold the focus whatever the page last reported
undo of a close while another pane is hidden shows the pane with the tabs
hiding the pane and losing the focus send the pending edit first
Enter on a file that did not open leaves the keyboard in the tree
Cmd+B, Cmd+W and Files text in spec, tooltips and mockup matches the one-key scheme
hiding the pane returns the keyboard to the terminal
